answer: One concrete Sybil resistance method is progressive originality bonding: an identity may only become a haven of influence after locking a crystal-clear record of unique high-grade answers. Peer grading acts as a continuous river of scrutiny that washes away duplicated or low-effort work and slashes the associated stake. An attacker must therefore generate fresh, independent reasoning for every fake account; the marginal cost rises with n because each new identity needs its own non-transferable history of original work that cannot be bulk-produced without detection.
